text:
**Overall:** 5/10. The package is small and readable, but I would not approve it as-is because the advertised fresh tiny demo is broken and the research validation logic has several unchecked assumptions.

**Verification:** after installing declared deps, `python -m pytest` ran 7 tests: 6 passed, 1 failed. The failure is `test_tiny_end_to_end`, because `data/stories/manifest.json` is missing.

**Concrete Issues**

| Severity | Location | Issue |
|---|---|---|
| high | [emovec/data.py](/work/emovec/data.py:24) lines 24-36 | Extraction requires `data/stories/manifest.json` and story files, but the repo has no `data/` files and no generation fallback. |
| high | [tests/test_integration_tiny.py](/work/tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12) line 12 | The only end-to-end test fails on a clean checkout, so the repo is not currently self-verifying. |
| medium | [README.md](/work/README.md:11) lines 11, 54-65 | README claims stories can be generated and `make demo` runs the tiny demo, but neither works from this checkout. |
| medium | [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:226) lines 226-240 | HF steering falls back to steering every prompt token when offsets are unavailable or missed, corrupting the intended activity-token intervention. |
| medium | [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:262) lines 262-308 | HF preference scoring is a single “good minus bad” next-token score, not the pairwise preference logits described by the method/README. |
| medium | [emovec/validate_contexts.py](/work/emovec/validate_contexts.py:21) lines 21-28 | Vector artifacts are not checked against the selected backend/model/layer/dimension before use, so stale or cross-backend vectors fail late or produce invalid comparisons. |
| medium | [emovec/validate_contexts.py](/work/emovec/validate_contexts.py:66) lines 66-76 | If `afraid` is absent, the dosage probe silently uses the first emotion vector while still writing `afraid_dosage` outputs. |
| medium | [emovec/extract.py](/work/emovec/extract.py:38) lines 38-61 | Extraction does not validate that every configured emotion has loaded examples before indexing/staking outputs, leading to cryptic `KeyError`/`ValueError` failures. |
| low | [emovec/vector_ops.py](/work/emovec/vector_ops.py:20) lines 20-32 | `pc_variance_threshold: 0` still selects one principal component, so users cannot disable neutral-PC projection via config. |
| low | [emovec/steer_prefs.py](/work/emovec/steer_prefs.py:45) lines 45-49 | `config.yaml` exposes `steering.min_reported_emotions`, but the implementation hard-codes 4 and ignores the setting. |

**Lines To Rewrite:** about 300 lines. Most of that is adding deterministic story generation or checking in the dataset, hardening config/artifact validation, fixing HF steering token selection, replacing the preference probe with real pairwise scoring, and adding tests around those paths.

**Bottom Line:** No, I would not approve this PR as-is.

issues.description: Extraction requires data/stories manifest and story files, but the repo has no data files and no generation fallback.
The clean-checkout tiny end-to-end test fails because the required story manifest is missing.
Documentation claims story generation and a runnable tiny demo, but those commands fail from this checkout.
HF steering falls back to all prompt tokens when activity offsets are unavailable or missed.
HF preference scoring uses a single good-minus-bad next-token score instead of true pairwise preference logits.
Loaded vector artifacts are not validated against the selected backend, model, layer, or dimensionality.
Dosage validation silently uses the first emotion vector when afraid is absent while still labeling outputs as afraid.
Extraction does not validate that every configured emotion has examples before saving stacked arrays.
A PCA variance threshold of 0 still removes one component instead of disabling projection.
The min_reported_emotions config value is ignored because steering always hard-codes four emotions.
